READY TO TAKE YOUR WAREHOUSE SKILLS TO THE NEXT LEVEL?

Are you an experienced warehouse worker and confident operating warehouse equipment? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as an EPT, OPT, Reachtruck or Forklift Driver!

Full-time availability – You are available for 40 hours per week.

Relevant experience – Experience with EPT, OPT, reachtruck or forklift work is preferred.

Certificate – A valid certificate for the equipment you operate is a plus.

Own transportation – You can independently travel to and from work.

English skills – You can communicate in English at work.

Safety-minded & reliable – You work carefully, take responsibility and follow safety instructions.

Team player – You enjoy working together with colleagues to get the job done.

Do you want to keep your cool while staying warm? ❄️ Join the Forklift Driver team in Oss! You will be working in a frozen warehouse of +2 / -18 degrees, but don't worry, you’ll be sitting comfortably in a state-of-the-art heated cabin. Ready to lift your career to new heights? Apply nowww! 💸

What we offer
- A great hourly wage of € 15.63!
- Shift allowance of 8.75% and € 0.25 per hour extra
- Weekly payment of your salary!
- 2 shifts!
6:00-15:00
15:00-00:00
- You can work overtime and weekends for extra cash!
- Location Oss at a Family Company!

Who you are
To be the best fit for our team in Oss, it is important that you meet these requirements, you speak English or Dutch and you have a valid forklift certificate and experience.

- You can work in Oss.

What will you do
As a Forklift Driver Heated Cabin, you are the master of the aisles. Together with your team, you ensure all frozen products are stored perfectly. Ensure trucks are loaded and unloaded with high precision!

Where will you work
As a Forklift Driver Heated Cabin you will be working for a successful family company in the Netherlands. We pride ourselves on having a strong, professional team where everyone knows each other. Even though we work in the cold, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. We offer a stable workplace where you can really build your future!

Job application
Ready to score this job as Forklift Driver? I thought so! Apply now for this Forklift Driver position using the application button. If you have any questions, please call 0412 - 642555.  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

You’ll soon be working for a company that specializes in producing all kinds of stone worktops. These worktops are sold throughout the Netherlands and Germany and eventually end up in people’s homes, so there’s a good chance that you already have one of their worktops in your own kitchen!

As an Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the finishing tasks that cannot be completed by machines. You’ll be working on detailed operations using hand tools and small machinery. Once you’ve mastered your own process, you’ll have the opportunity to move on to the next department within production!

Your main tasks will include:

- Assembling materials using hand tools
- Reading technical drawings
- Performing quality checks
- Communicating with the machining department
- Keeping your workspace clean and organized

Your new job as an Assembly Worker takes place in a day shift, Monday to Friday, from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm. Leaving your weekends free!

- Living in Zevenhuizen, Rotterdam, The Hague, Leiden, Alphen aan den Rijn, Gouda, Zoetermeer, or surrounding areas
- Please keep in mind that it is not possible to travel to work by public transport.
- Available to work a day shift from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm
- Experience using hand tools or hobby experience in making furniture
- Good command of Dutch or English

Are you technically inclined and enjoy working independently? As a digital print operator, you will be the driving force behind an advanced printing machine. You will ensure the printing process runs smoothly, from loading paper rolls to performing maintenance. You will oversee the entire process from start to finish, making you responsible for the final product!

What will you do?

- Prepare and manage paper supply
- Manage paper and ink inventory
- Set up and operate the printing machine
- Oversee the printing process, including post-production
- Perform general maintenance
- Develop and maintain the production schedule

- You speak either Dutch or English fluently
- You live near Etten-Leur (within a 30 km radius)
- You are eager to learn and have a proactive attitude
- You have your own transportation

Do you have experience as a supervisor? Are you looking for a responsible job? Are you able to optimize day-to-day activities while minimizing costs? Then we are looking for you!

What are you going to do?
- Organize workflow by assigning responsibilities and preparing schedules
- Responsible for scheduling control
- Maintain material control and quality control
- Responsible for other duties on assembly line
- Oversee and coach employees
- Identify issues in efficiency and suggest improvements
- Enforce strict safety guidelines and company standards.

What do we offer?
In addition to a competitive and negotiable salary, we offer:

- weekly payment of this salary,
- 8% holiday allowance and 25 days of leave (on a full-time basis),
- participation in the pension scheme from day 1, and
- personal development. During your contract you have access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Our client is an employer that offers equal opportunities for everyone and embraces diversity in the employee population. Our client is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department.

You often work together with (international) colleagues. They communicate with each other in English or Dutch.

What do we ask?
- High School degree, college degree preferred
- Minimum 5+ years of relative working experience in electronic or computer industry preferred
- Solid understanding of computer system assembly
- Possess basic mechanical knowledge
- Familiarity with computer or electronic components testing and inspection
- Experience with mechanical assembly, cable routing, and quality standards
- Strong attention to detail, including accuracy and thoroughness
- Ability to comprehend spoken and written English
- Ability to work overtime and weekends depending on business demands.

Are you interested?
Apply quickly via the application button!

Are you a cheerful multitasker with a driver's license? 🚗💨 Then we are looking for you as a delivery driver for AH Online! Get started at Albert Heijn in Dordrecht, and discover the flexible working hours. 📅

After 13 weeks you also earn €18,83 per hour! NICE! 💰 This great job is a real #baanrader! 🤩

Would you like to know more about this position? Then read on! 👇

What we offer
- Earn € 150 when you bring a friend!
- Earn € 18,83 per hour after thirteen weeks!
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Flexible working hours
- Travel allowance
- An in-house Tempo-Team office!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you are physically able to lift heavy crates. You can also work independently to deliver groceries on time. What else you need to know:

- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are in possession of a driving license B for at least six months;
- You have private transport to get to the location.

What will you do
No day is the same as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. But that's also what makes the work so much fun! You start each shift by collecting the key and the route lists. You can also take something tasty from the refrigerator with you for the road. Time to deliver! You drive to the right locations via your navigation. Here, you can deliver your groceries to your door. You also check the payment like a real professional. Everything arranged? Time to leave again! You get into the van and return to the depot. Here, you clean the car for the next working day. Ready to hit the road again! Do you enjoy it so much that you want to continue growing after a while? Then you can always become a buddy, for example!

Where will you work
Working as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online means a lot of contact with different people. In other words: a nice and fun team! You will meet each other in the waiting area during each service. A great opportunity to get to know each other even better! Drink a cup of coffee together! Or get so

As an Assembly & Repair Technician, you work in a modern production environment. Together with 6 to 8 colleagues per shift, you make sure technical parts are assembled, checked and prepared for shipment.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling technical parts according to drawings and work instructions
- Repairing and checking plastic, metal and wooden parts
- Packing fragile parts in large crates for international transport
- Carrying out quality checks during and after the work
- Working with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- Reporting defects or deviations to your supervisor
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe

You work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 to 15:00
- Afternoon/evening shift: 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- For this role, we ask:- You are available full-time for a 2-shift schedule
- You live in the Eindhoven, Veldhoven, Best or Helmond region
- You have experience in technical work, assembly or repair
- You can work with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- You can read technical drawings and follow work instructions
- You have a good command of English, both spoken and written
- Experience with accurate and independent working is a plus

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. Every day, we process up to 200,000 packages here, which can be sorted to 150 locations. In any case, wherever you work: we *always* listen to what you have to say. The more perspectives and opinions we hear, the better we all become. For instance, as an organization, we received the Great Place to Work certificate this year. This certification is based 100% on employee feedback.

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel

Looking for a stable full-time job with a good salary and great benefits?

Then this could be the job for you!

We are looking for motivated Warehouse Workers to join the DHL Supply Chain team in Weert. No long experience needed – you will receive training on the job and have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Full-time availability – You are available to work 40 hours per week. Dayshift & 2-shifts available.

Own transportation – You can travel to and from the workplace independently.

English skills – You can communicate in English at work.

Reliable and motivated – You are dependable, willing to work hard and enjoy working in team.

As a demolition worker, you are responsible for carrying out demolition and clean-up activities safely and efficiently. Experience is not required; motivation and a practical attitude are most important.

Your tasks include:

- Demolishing walls, floors and other constructions using hand tools and small machinery
- Cleaning and removing debris from demolition sites
- Separating construction waste and materials according to safety regulations
- Assisting colleagues during renovation and demolition projects
- Loading and unloading materials and tools
- Following VGM and safety instructions on-site
- Keeping the workplace clean and organised

You work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Early shift: Monday to Friday from 06:00 to 15:00
- Late shift: Monday to Friday from 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance on top of your salary.

For this position, it is important that you enjoy physical work and can work safely on construction and demolition sites.

We ask the following:

- You have an active and practical working attitude
- You are physically fit and able to perform heavy work
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift schedule
- You understand basic safety and VGM instructions
- You can work both independently and in a team
- A driver's license B is an advantage
- You have a good command of the English language

Are you a hands-on professional with a keen eye for order, safety, and efficiency? As a Logistics Operator, you ensure that all raw materials, packaging supplies, and finished products are delivered to the right place at the right time. Working independently in a dynamic production environment, you are the crucial link between the warehouse and the production lines. With a salary of up to €3,500 per month including shift allowance in a 3-shift system, you are also well rewarded for your efforts!

Functieomschrijving:
As a Logistics Operator, you will operate the forklift and carry out a variety of logistics tasks, including:
• Supplying and removing raw and auxiliary materials as well as finished products from the production lines.
• Moving materials between the warehouse, loading docks, and production department.
• Stacking pallets and processing waste streams.
• Completing transport and waste registration forms in line with procedures.
• Cleaning and maintaining logistics tools and equipment.
• Identifying bottlenecks and proposing improvements.

Functievereisten:
You are the right candidate if you:
• Have an MBO-level background.
• Bring experience in logistics or production processes (a plus).
• Hold a valid forklift license, or are willing to obtain one.
• Are flexible, stress-resistant, and take responsibility.
• Have a good command of the English language.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:
In return for your commitment as a Logistics Operator, you will receive:
• A gross monthly salary of up to €3,500 including shift allowance.
• An independent role in a healthy, modern production company.
• Opportunities for internal growth toward Coordinator or Team Leader positions.
• A dedicated team with short communication lines.
Ready to become the driving force of this factory's logistics? Apply now and take your career to the next level!
